story.heading: A Collegeville crew for the whole outdoor room
paragraphs: WJA Landscaping is the contractor you call when the backyard needs a patio, a kitchen, light, and plants that survive this climate.
The map is Collegeville, Gilbertsville, and Limerick Township. Weekdays run 7 to 5. Call 610-831-3819 for the estimate.

experience.heading: How a landscape job should start.
items: Walk the yard. They design against what you already have, not a stock rendering.
Hardscape and planting get sequenced so the patio isn't waiting on a shrub order.
Lighting is part of the plan, not a leftover string of spots.

feature.heading: An outdoor kitchen only works if the patio does
feature.text: WJA builds the hardscape, the kitchen, the light, and the planting as one backyard. Collegeville weather is the constraint. The crew already knows it.

contact.heading: Call for the <mark>estimate.</mark>
contact.sub: Collegeville, Gilbertsville, Limerick Township. Weekdays 7 to 5. Confirm a Saturday crew on the official site.
